headline: Clinton order set up a presidential commission on celebrating women in American history.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order created a President's Commission on the Celebration of Women in American History. No summary was provided, so details about the commission's members, duties, and length of service are not available here.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 29, 1998. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, but the source does not say.
